chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, who said: al-Jahm ibn al-Hakam al-Mada'ini narrated to me, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Give charity, for indeed charity increases wealth abundantly, and give charity — may God have mercy upon you.'

key_terms.الصدقة: Sadaqa — voluntary charity given for God's sake; distinct from obligatory zakat
key_terms.تزيد: Increases, multiplies; the divine blessing that causes wealth to grow through giving

ai.seo_question: Does giving charity increase wealth according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a prophetic hadith in which the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) commands his community to give charity (sadaqa), promising that it increases rather than diminishes wealth. The repeated exhortation 'give charity' and the closing invocation 'may God have mercy upon you' reflect the warm, encouraging tone of prophetic teaching. This tradition was understood by early Muslims as a divine guarantee that generosity is spiritually and materially beneficial.
word_analysis: may He have mercy upon you

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah who said, ‘Al Jahm Bin Al Hakam Al Madainy narrated to me from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Give charity for the charity increases in the wealth a lot, and give charity, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be Merciful upon you’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah, from al-Jahm ibn al-Hakam al-Mada’iniy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘Give charity; charity increases wealth a great deal. Give charity, may Allah grant you favors.’”
